text: Read sample outcomes without treating them as a complete deck.

One recorded fictional design earned a high diagnostic rating but failed two required capability thresholds. This illustrates why eligibility must be checked independently of optional score. A different worked design met its minimums and received a positive rating at its submitted price. Neither case reconstructs every available option card.

items: An example card might cost $100,000 and reduce capacity by two people. It reduces speed by 10 km/h and increases resilience by two points. Other values must be specified, not guessed.
